ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixel distribution with sparse, localized high-intensity (white) pixel spikes creating a high-contrast ratio on a micro-scale but low ratio globally.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous dark geometric field covering the majority of the visible surface; mapped with high-frequency, non-contiguous white pixel clusters (1-10 pixel diameter) scattered across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: U-shaped central depression with a wide pixel angle of approximately 135 degrees and a shallow depth relative to the lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular linear boundary exhibiting high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) across the entire span, with higher amplitude serrations visible towards the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curves extending from the median notch to the outer tips, terminating in sharp, acute angles.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous high-contrast white circular and sub-circular pixel clusters distributed across the dark field, primarily concentrated on the central and mid-lobe regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple thin, high-intensity white linear disruptions (10-50 pixels in length) oriented at various angles, breaking the dark pigmentation pattern.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive diffuse white pitting and micro-scarring visible across the entire surface of both fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced high-intensity white tip on the extreme distal edge of the right lobe.
